scope: Original exposed TRAIN assessment, all retained eleven models; no modified predictions
definition: Class/type pair supported iff at least one FIT row has that ordered subject/object type pair and class. Null is always allowed. Unseen FIT type pairs are reported separately.
outputs: All40 Macro identity, correct/error by empirical support of gold and predicted class; deployed gold-positive wrong-positive errors separately; all models and all40 class supports retained.
interpretation: FIT absence is not semantic incompatibility; no executable mask, accuracy projection, rare-class rescue, confirmatory inference or claim of new input information.
